brief:
The Palestinian Red Crescent Society announced Sunday the death of Raafat Khayri Ahmad Abu Khalil, a young man from Ateel north of Tulkarm, following his detention by Israeli occupation forces at Anab military checkpoint east of Tulkarm city, Shehab Wire reported.

The Red Crescent did not immediately provide further details about the circumstances of the death or the duration of detention.
